label: Cyberpunk city
prompt: Capture a beautiful atmospheric cyberpunk city street at night in rich coherent pixel art: violet and cyan neon, wet pavement reflections, detailed architecture painted into the fixed wall surfaces, warm windows, readable midtone slab edges. EXACTLY THREE sound objects: rain pattering on wet street pavement (bed, an animated puddle), a ventilation unit humming (bed, a recognizable industrial vent), and a futuristic electric vehicle passing once (event, a small hovering vehicle, random gaps 12-25 seconds). No speech, sirens or music. Only these three objects; no decorative freestanding objects. Preserve the normal full room dimensions. Use restrained detailed material shading, readable silhouettes and a cohesive palette.
reviewNotes: Three curated sources, two beds plus one quieter distant random event. Initial source placements tuned for the demo.
